# has tag

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasTag`](gmeow-hasTag.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasTag>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/tags`](../../slices/tags.md)

Relates an entity to a user-minted tag — the 80% flat shortcut. Non-functional: an entity may carry many co-equal tags. Period, confidence, tagger and suppression are carried via RDF-star statement annotations ([`gmeow:validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md), [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md), [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md), [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md)) on the shortcut; promote to a [`gmeow:Tagging`](../classes/gmeow-Tagging.md) relator when the act itself must be a node.
